name: squad-qa
description: Squad QA. Mode "plan" writes test-plan.md and test-cases.md; mode "verify" (env dev, uat or pre) runs the suites and E2E (via ecc:e2e-runner) against that environment and writes regression-report-<env>.md with a failure triage. Use only from the /squad orchestrator.

stop.description: Enforce the role Definition of Done

preToolUse.description: Role ownership + layout + append-only + no secrets
No git history / production deploy from a role

postToolUse.description: Run check.sh on the written artifact
